# Developer guides
# Frequently Asked Questions
How do I get access to Pylon's API?
Please visit the [API Settings](https://app.getpylon.com/settings/api) in your Team Settings and contact our support staff.
Can you integrate with my custom CRM?
We can help your developers use our API. We can also develop bespoke integrations; please chat to our support staff and ask about custom API integrations.
Does the API cost extra?
No, using the API itself does not incur additional charges. However, our API may trigger downstream activities which could cost money.
Can my web developer send website leads into Pylon?
Yes, this is a common flow to get your leads rapidly into Pylon without any need for manual data entry. Send this page to your website contractor!

title: File Storage API Docs — Pylon AI
snippet:
Upload any file and get a public URL. Supports multipart file upload or fetching from a remote URL. Files are stored for 30 days with unguessable URLs that serve as access tokens. No API key required — payment via x402.

## Pricing
**$0.005 USDC per upload** — paid via x402 on Base (Coinbase L2). File retrieval is free.

snippet:
Programmatic access to read and write data in Pylon
Pylon’s API can be used to programmatically access and take action on data within Pylon.
Only Admin users can create API tokens. To learn more about Admins, see [Roles & User Management](https://docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/platform/roles-and-user-management).

Check out our [API Reference](https://docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/developer/api/api-reference) for specifications on all endpoints. To call the API from TypeScript, Python, or Go, use our [SDKs](https://docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/developer/api/sdks), with pinned installation commands and upgrade guidance for each language.
Before you build an integration, read:
- [API conventions](https://docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/developer/api/conventions) for IDs, timestamps, pagination, search filters, update behavior, files, and slugs
- [Rate limits](https://docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/developer/api/rate-limits) for request limits and how to handle `429` responses
- [Errors](https://docs.usepylon.com/pylon-docs/developer/api/errors) for error codes and response format

Pricing
# Pay per request.
That's it.
No subscriptions. No tiers. No invoices. Every API call is a micropayment via x402.
$0.01
per API request (most APIs — search from $0.003)
- No API keys or accounts required
- No minimum spend or commitments
- No rate limits — pay and use
- Instant settlement on Base (L2)
- Sub-second payment verification
- Works with any x402-compatible client
## All APIs, one price model
Every endpoint uses pay-per-request. No tiers, no surprises.

The x402 Flow
## How payment works
x402 is an open protocol by Coinbase that enables machine-to-machine payments over HTTP. Here's what happens on every request:
1
### Request
Your agent sends a normal HTTP request to the API endpoint. No special headers needed on the first call.
2
### 402 Challenge
Server returns `HTTP 402` with payment details: amount, token, recipient address, and network.
3
### Settlement
The x402 client signs a USDC payment on Base L2, attaches it as a header, and resends. API delivers the result.
